title: NuPAY — race condition: test asserts on a request before it settles
symptom: NuPAY payment tests fail intermittently/consistently because Playwright asserts on a network request (purchase/order status) before the request resolves. The expected request/response that the test waits to validate has not completed yet, so the assertion sees a stale or missing value. Affects several NuPAY test cases at once in a regression.
recipe: This is a test-side race condition, not a product bug. Do NOT relax the assertion. The test must explicitly wait for the relevant request/response to settle before asserting: await the orders status request (waitForResponse on the purchase/order-status endpoint, or the existing assertOrderStatusRequest* helper) and assert on its resolved body, instead of racing the network call. Previous fix updated the affected NuPAY specs to await the request before validating.
